name: marketing-council
description: Marketing strategy skills with an executable knowledge graph connecting marketing schools, principles, applied theories, specialist agents, evidence gates, and measurable tactics.

interface.longDescription: Marketing Council makes ChatGPT and Codex diagnose before prescribing. Its neural marketing graph connects established schools and principles with dated 2026 evidence for AI-mediated discovery, agentic commerce, autonomous media, creator commerce, commerce media, signal design, and causal measurement, then routes the decision through specialist roles and challenge gates.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this marketing problem before recommending tactics.
Run a council debate on this strategy and tell me what decision the evidence supports.
Red-team this marketing plan, then rebuild the parts that would fail commercially.
